component.name: Audible Backup
component.summary: Back up your Audible library as chapter-split MP3s

description.p: Audible Backup makes a personal, DRM-free copy of the audiobooks you have bought. It signs in to your own Audible account, downloads your titles, and converts them into chapter-split, tagged MP3 files that play in any music player — no subscription required to keep listening.

ul.li: Sign in to Audible from the app; your password is only ever typed on Amazon's own page
Browse your library, search it, and pick the books you want
One click downloads a book and converts it, with a live progress log
Splits each book into one MP3 per chapter, with cover art and tags
Handles both classic AAX and newer AAXC titles
Saves finished audiobooks straight into your Music folder

description.p: This tool is for backing up audiobooks you own. It uses your own account and credentials, in the same way desktop tools like ffmpeg have long supported personal-use decryption. Removing DRM may be restricted where you live and by Audible's terms of service.

screenshot.caption: The library, with each book's download and conversion state
Connecting an Audible account, which happens on Audible's own page

description.p: First release with a desktop application: a real window, its own icon, and no terminal.

ul.li: Audiobooks are converted straight into your Music folder
Audible sign-in opens in your normal browser
